title: Lights and vessels: the vessel makes the light what it is, limits it, and grows with it
overview:
Chapter 27 turns from *Abba* and *Ima* to *Zeir Anpin*, but first lays down an introduction on lights and vessels. From the side of the lights the *sefiros* are *bli ma*, without what; it is the vessels, the *tikunim*, the Names, that make a *sefira* *chachma* or *bina*. The three rulers, brain, heart and liver, are the vessels of the soul, and counted out the vessels of *Zeir Anpin* are the 248 limbs of the King.

In general a vessel is like the eye that turns the life force into seeing. It does two things: it changes the light from spiritual to physical, and it limits it. A weightlifter builds up the vessel, not the light; a brain that did not develop is not a lesser soul; a mother in a panic lifts a car, because the moving power came through without the vessel's limit. Matter is the end of the form made thick, so the first cell already holds the whole person, and vessel and light grow together: the brain of a child who is not educated does not grow, and the brain of one who fills it with light grows until seventy.

sections.title: Before Zeir Anpin, an introduction on lights and vessels
sections.summary: The tape opens on the end of chapter 26, the levels of the intellect and the inner union of *Abba*. Chapter 27 turns to *Zeir Anpin*, but first sets out the general matter of lights and vessels, which runs through the next chapters.

phrases.he: (כז) והנה אחר שנתבאר דרך פרט קצת בענין אורות דאבא ואמא ובחינת יחודם בפנימיות וחיצוניות כנזכר לעיל, מעתה יש לבאר פרטי ענין אורות דזעיר אנפין שנקרא ישראל ויעקב
וכל פרטי היחודים דזעיר אנפין ונוקבה שנקרא יחוד ישראל ולאה או יחוד יעקב ורחל כו' כידוע.

blocks.text: The tape opens on the end of chapter 26. To change the way he was going, a man has to reach up into the *middos* of *Arich* and actually change them. At the second level of *chachma* he looks into what the *ratzon* (will) for the *middos* should be: he reaches up into the *zro'os* (the arms) of *Arich*, which are dressed inside his *chachma* and *bina*.
blocks.outOfPlace: Class 041 opens by finishing the previous tape's discussion of chapter 26 (the levels of the intellect, the inner union of Abba) before it reads line 1, which sums that chapter up; placed here.

blocks.text: There is always a level like this. In everybody there is a certain fanaticism: Americans will tell you that America is the thing. By them it is a *hanacha sichlis* (an intellectual premise), because their *ratzon* is like that.
blocks.outOfPlace: Class 041 opens by finishing the previous tape's discussion of chapter 26 before it reads line 1; placed here.

blocks.text: The third level is the normal day-to-day *sechel* (intellect). He is not looking into what life is all about, or what G-d is, certainly not; not even into what his morality should be, or to reevaluate his *middos*: they are already evaluated. Of each thing he only asks whether he likes it and how it compares to the *hanacha sichlis*, the *sechel* he already has.
blocks.outOfPlace: Class 041 opens by finishing the previous tape's discussion of chapter 26 before it reads line 1; placed here.

blocks.text: New offspring, which above is the birth of the souls from the union of *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*, need the inner union of *Abba*, coming from the *mazalos* (lit. flows). And the coming of *Moshiach*, he told us, depends *davka* on *hisbonenus* (contemplation) in the inner side of the *mochin*.

phrases.he: אך תחלה יש להבין הקדמה בענין אורות וכלים בכלל
phrases.en: Before we get into the *inyanim* of *Zeir Anpin*, he's going to explain the whole general *inyan* of *oros v'kelim*.

phrases.he: ובפרט
דהנה ידוע פירוש מה שאמר דאיהו וחיוהי חד הן אורות, ואיהו וגרמוהי חד הן בחינת הכלים

blocks.text: Before the *inyanim* (matters) of *Zeir Anpin*, the general matter of *oros v'kelim*, lights and vessels, is explained, and it runs through the next three or four chapters. This is still the end of *yichuda ila'a* (the higher unity), but already the beginning of *yichuda tata'a* (the lower unity) too. Then the known teaching is read: *ihu v'chayohi chad* are the lights, *ihu v'garmohi chad* the vessels.

sections.title: The lights are without what; the vessels make a sefira what it is
sections.summary: From the side of the lights the ten *sefiros* are *bli ma*, without what. What makes a *sefira* *chachma* or *bina* is its vessel: the *tikunim*, the four Names, the holy Name of the *Zohar* are all vessels.

phrases.he: ומצד בחינת האורות דעשר ספירות בכלל ובפרט נקרא עשר ספירות בלי מה, בלי מהות
וכמו שכתוב ולאו מכל אינון מדות כלל כו'
אך מצד בחינת הכלים הן בבחינת מציאות דבר מה
וזה שכתוב אפיק י' תיקונין וקרינן לון עשר ספירין כו'
phrases.en: *Davka* the *tikunim* means the enclothments; that's really what's called a *sefira*.

phrases.he: לאחזאה כו' לאנהגא בהון עלמין כו'

blocks.text: From the lights, the ten *sefiros* are *bli ma*, without what; from the vessels, they are a something. What makes a thing *chachma* or *bina*, its *mahus*, is not so much its light: it is the vessels. So *davka* **the *tikunim* means the enclothments**: that is what is called a *sefira*.

phrases.he: וכן מה שכללות עשר ספירות דאצילות נקרא בד' שמות, ע''ב ס''ג מ''ה ב''ן
ע''ב במילוי יודין בחכמה
וס''ג ביודי''ן וא' בבינה
ומ''ה במלוי אלפין בזעיר אנפין, וב''ן במילוי ההי''ן במלכות כידוע
ובלשון הזהר כלל העשר ספירות נקרא רזא דשמא קדישא בלבד
phrases.en: It's called the secret of the holy name.

phrases.he: כידוע הכל הוא רק מצד בחינת הכלים דוקא כידוע.
phrases.en: All it is, it's *davka* the *kelim*.

blocks.text: So too the four Names in which the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* are known, *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH* and *BaN*, each with its *milui* (spelling out), for *chachma*, *bina*, *Zeir Anpin* and *Malchus*: the Names too are vessels. In the language of the *Zohar* the ten *sefiros* are **called the secret of the holy name**, and **all it is, it's *davka* the *kelim***.

sections.title: Brain, heart and liver: the vessels of the soul and the body of the King
sections.summary: The three rulers, brain, heart and liver, are the body's three systems and the vessels of *neshama*, *ruach* and *nefesh*. Each vessel has a head, an inside and an end; counted out, the vessels of *Zeir Anpin* are the 248 limbs of the King, and from their garments the souls come.

phrases.he: וביאור הדברים ידוע על מאמר דתלת שליטין לעילא, מוחא ולבא וכבדא
phrases.en: There's three controllers: the brain, the heart, and the liver.

phrases.he: כו', שהן בחינת ג' כלים לנר''ן
נשמה במוחא ורוח בלבא ונפש בכבדא כו'
אבל בחינת חיה יחידה, הוא למעלה מהגבלת כלים כו'

blocks.text: The known saying: three rulers above, **the brain, the heart, and the liver**. They are the head, the upper torso and the lower torso, the three systems that run the body: the brain; the heart with the lungs, which bring the air into the body; and the liver, which means the whole digestive system (a student supplies the English word).

blocks.title: Spirit, air and fuel
blocks.text: In other words: the nervous, cardiovascular and digestive systems. The brain is the spirit, the heart the air, the liver the food. To make combustion you need air and wood, and food is basically wood: fuel, plant material. Even meat is plant material: the cow ate the plant and you ate the cow.

That is the external side. The internal side is *Chabad*, *Chagas* and *Nehi*: the brain is the intellect, the heart is the *middos*, the feelings, and the liver is the instincts, what they call the gut feelings. These are the three vessels for *nefesh*, *ruach* and *neshama*: *neshama* in the brain, *ruach* in the heart, *nefesh* in the liver. *Chaya* and *yechida* are above the limits of vessels.

phrases.he: ובבחינת הכלים כלול מראש תוך סוף,
phrases.en: The way the *kelim* are made is there's the head, the inside, and the end, which the head is the real inside.

phrases.he: שהוא פנימית הכלים ואמצעית הכלים וחיצונית הכלים כו'
phrases.en: It means the *pnimiyus*, the middle, and outside.

blocks.text: Every vessel has a head, an inside and an end, *rosh, toch, sof*, and **the head is the real inside**, the *pnimiyus* (inner side). So head, inside and end are **the *pnimiyus*, the middle, and outside** of the vessels.

phrases.he: וכידוע בענין רמ''ח איברים דמלכא דט׳ ספירות של בחינת זעיר אנפין
שט' פעמים ט' עולה פ''א
phrases.en: Nine times nine equals 81.

phrases.he: וג' פעמים ט׳ פעמים ט׳ נגד ג' מדריגות שבכלים, ראש תוך סוף הנזכר לעיל, עולה רמ''ג
וה׳ חסדים המגדילים הוא רמ''ח
phrases.en: With the *chassadim magdilim*, that's 248.

phrases.he: והוא כללות ענין כלים דזעיר אנפין שנקרא גופא דמלכא

blocks.text: The 248 limbs of the King: the nine *sefiros* of *Zeir Anpin*, each of them made of nine. **Nine times nine equals 81** (he and a student check the wording in the student's book). Three times that, for the head, inside and end of the vessels, is 243.

The five *chassadim hamagdilim* (the kindnesses that make grow) are like the *chassadim* of *Arich*; *Torah Or* explains it, if you want to look it up. They are the inner spread of life into the whole thing. **With the *chassadim magdilim*, that's 248**: all the vessels of *Zeir Anpin*, called the *gufa d'malka* (the body of the King).

phrases.he: וגם לבושין תקינת לון,
דמנהון פרחין נשמתין כו'
phrases.en: The *nishmasin* of people come from the *levushim* of the *kelim* of the *gufa d'malka*.

phrases.he: שהן לבושין דמחשבה כו'
phrases.en: What are the *levushim*? *Machshava*, *dibur*, *maaseh*.

phrases.he: כמו שיתבאר הכל
phrases.en: Later he'll explain everything.

blocks.text: The vessels have *levushim* (garments), from which the souls fly out: **the *nishmasin* of people come from the *levushim* of the *kelim* of the *gufa d'malka***. The garments are *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*, thought, speech and action, as will be explained later.

sections.title: Light and vessel in general: the life force in an organ, changed from spiritual to physical
sections.summary: In general, light and vessel are like the life force of sight in the eye: the life force is *bli ma*, and the eye makes it seeing. The first thing the vessel does is change the light's essence, from spiritual to physical.

phrases.he: ואמנם הנה ענין אור וכלי דרך כלל,
phrases.en: Now in general, the whole thing of *or v'kli derech klal*.

phrases.he: הגם שיש בו הרבה אופנים שונים מאד,
phrases.en: There's many different ways of explaining it and very many different ways of what it's talking about.

phrases.he: אך כללותו הוא על דרך אור וחיות הרוחני של ראיה רוחנית כשמתלבש וממוזג בהגשמה בכלי חומר העין
phrases.en: The life force is the light, and when it encloses in the eye, it becomes a thing of seeing.

phrases.he: בבחינת ראיה גשמית

blocks.text: That was the particulars; now light and vessel in general. It is like the spiritual life force of sight dressed in the matter of the eye, like the limbs of the King: **the life force is the light, and when it encloses in the eye, it becomes a thing of seeing**. The life force itself is *bli ma*.

phrases.he: שיש בזה ב' דברים,
הא' שינוי המהות מרוחניות לגשמיות
שהראות גשמי יתפוס בגשם, מה שאין כן ברוחניות אור הראיה
וכן אור וכח השכל הרוחני הממוזג בגשם כלי המוח,
עד שנקרא התחכמות
phrases.en: And then the light is called *hischakmus*.

phrases.he: וכח התנועה בתנועת הגשם
phrases.en: And that becomes *tnua*.

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא בכח הצמיחה רוחנית שמורכב ומלובש בצמיחה גשמית בגשם הצומח

blocks.text: There are two things in this. The first is a change of essence, from spiritual to physical: physical sight grasps the physical, and the light of the spiritual intellect, blended into the brain, **is called *hischakmus*** (being smart). So a vessel is not really like a glass; it is an organ with the life force in it. The power of movement **becomes *tnua*** (movement), and the spiritual power of growth is dressed in the growing plant.

sections.title: The vessel limits the light: the weightlifter and the mother who lifted the car
sections.summary: The second thing the vessel does is limit and measure the light. Training builds the vessel, not the light, and a brain that did not develop does not mean a lesser soul; when the moving power comes through without the vessel's limit, in a panic, a man can do far more than his body can.

phrases.he: והב' ענין ההגבלה ושיעור שבחומר הכלי, מוגבל ונמדד בשיעור
כמו בראיה גשמית עד ס' מילין כו'
וכן ענין התחכמות
phrases.en: According to the person's brain he'll be able to have a certain amount of *hischakmus*.

phrases.he: ותנועת הגשם,
phrases.en: *Hatnua hagashmis* also will be according to the body.

phrases.he: מתפשטים בהגבלה מצומצמת דוקא, עד שיכלה כחם המוגבלת כמו שתקצר גשם השגת כלי המוח ויכלה כחו מצד קוטן הכלי
וכן יוקטן ויופסק כח תנועה הגשמית שמכח היד, בפעולה או
בהגבהת משאוי
phrases.en: How much he can lift.

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא

blocks.text: The second thing is limit and measure: the matter of the vessel is limited and measured. Physical sight reaches sixty *mil*. **According to the person's brain he'll be able to have a certain amount of *hischakmus***, and movement **also will be according to the body**: they spread within a narrow limit until their strength runs out.

blocks.title: The weightlifter
blocks.text: Before weight lifting you can lift, say, 50 pounds; work out, and you lift 150. Did the light of your soul, your *koach hatnua* (power of movement), get any stronger? Not at all: the *kli* improved; "you built up the *kli*." So with all the rest: the particular thing comes *davka* from the vessel, and so does the limit.

blocks.title: A brain that did not develop is not a lesser soul
blocks.text: The light of the intellect, the life force that gives the *sechel* its power, is not really different. Sometimes, G-d forbid, people have Down syndrome: for whatever reason the brain did not develop properly in the womb. It does not mean they have a lesser soul. Had they known what caused it and stopped it from happening, this person could have been a genius, because the light of the soul would have been the same.

sensitivity.reason: Says a person with Down syndrome could have been a genius had the cause been found and prevented: a medical claim, and a remark that touches families of people with disabilities.
sensitivity.publishable: The light of the intellect, the life force that gives the *sechel* its power, is not really different. Sometimes, G-d forbid, a child's brain does not develop properly in the womb. It does not mean the child has a lesser soul: the light of the soul is the same.

blocks.title: The extra chromosome, drugs and alcohol
blocks.text: A student says Down syndrome is caused by an extra chromosome. Maybe, but other things can happen too: certain drugs the mother takes, or a baby born without proper sight; drinking too much alcohol in pregnancy, a student adds, can cause retardation, and had she not drunk it, it would not have been there. So the soul had the full power of the *sechel*, and really a bigger one: a retarded brain only shows it limited even more.

sensitivity.reason: Medical claims on the causes of Down syndrome and of disabilities in pregnancy, and the word 'retardation'.
sensitivity.publishable: Many things can damage the vessel before birth. So the soul had the full power of the *sechel*, and really a bigger one: a damaged brain only shows it limited even more.

blocks.text: It shows another thing too. There are food supplements they recommend for pregnant women, and if you take certain ones, the child will come out smarter than usual. How come? Because there is no real definition in the light of the soul; the difference is not coming from it.

sensitivity.reason: Says food supplements in pregnancy make a child smarter: advice a reader might act on.
sensitivity.publishable: It shows another thing too: what is done for the body before birth can make a child smarter. How come? Because there is no real definition in the light of the soul; the difference is not coming from it.

blocks.text: Though in the soul there are definitions too. The *Tanya* says the holiness at the time of marital union is very important, and also that sometimes a very high soul comes to a very low person. But with the same type of soul you could have had a much smarter or a much stupider child. And we do know there are souls of *Yetzira*, souls of *Beriya*, and so on.

phrases.he: מצד הגבלת הכח המניע
phrases.en: But the *hagbala* is from the *kli*.

phrases.he: (מה שאין כן מצד עצם כח הרוחני של המניע התנועה, שאין בו הגבלה והפסק
וראיה מהגבהת משא כבד הבא בבהלה פתאומית, ביתר הרבה מכחו, מצד בחינת המקיף כידוע)

blocks.text: The limit on how much he can lift is the limit of the moving power, **but the *hagbala* is from the *kli***. The essential spiritual power that moves has no limit and no stop. The proof: a heavy load lifted in a sudden panic, far beyond a man's strength, from the *makif* (encompassing light).

blocks.title: The mother who lifted the car
blocks.text: It is a known thing: a car turned over on a child, and the mother lifted up the whole car.

blocks.title: The father at the bar
blocks.text: Another case: a father was sitting at a bar when he got the news, G-d forbid, that his son had fallen in the war, and he squeezed the lip of the bar so hard he broke the wood. (It takes him and the class a while to find the word for the part he squeezed.)

blocks.title: The cinder block and the Chi
blocks.text: So too someone extremely panicked can run much faster than he otherwise could. In some of the Eastern disciplines they call it harnessing the power of the *Chi*: a man breaks a cinder block, which the physical strength of the body should not be able to do. First they do breath exercises and the like, and if you talk to them they tell you it is a mental thing, not a physical one.
So we see that when the moving power comes through without the limit, it can move more than the vessel by itself can.

sections.title: Matter is the end of the form made thick: from the end of the light, the beginning of the vessel
sections.summary: Matter limits the form, yet it is patterned on it, because it is made from the last level of the form itself. So the first cell, which looks like a blob of jelly, already holds the whole person, written in letters, and its cells build organs to receive the soul's powers.

phrases.he: וכך הוא כל ענין חומר וצורה
שהחומר, מלבד שהוא בא בשינוי המהות, הנה הוא מגביל לצורה
אבל החומר הוא מעין ודוגמת הצורה, כמו חומר כלי העין לראות, וחומר כלי המוח להשכיל
phrases.en: The *chomer* has to be in a way that it can be *mekabel* the *tzura*.

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא

blocks.text: So it is with all *chomer v'tzura*, matter and form. Matter, besides coming with a change of essence, limits the form. Yet matter is like the form and patterned on it, the matter of the eye to see and of the brain to understand: **the *chomer* has to be in a way that it can be *mekabel* the *tzura***, receive the form.

phrases.he: אבל החומר נעשה מהתעבות והגשמה של הצורה הרוחנית, מסוף כל המדריגות שבו
כמו מסוף המדריגה דרוחניות הצמיחה, נעשה כח צמיחה בגשם
וכמו סוף של חיות הרוחני דנפש, מלובש בדם, כמו שכתוב כי הדם הוא הנפש כו'
וכך סוף המדריגה של אור השכל הרוחני מתמזג בחומר כלי המוח,
וכן סוף הגשמה דרוחניות הראיה ממוזג בחומר העין

blocks.text: Matter is the spiritual form grown thick, from the end of its levels: from the end of the spirituality of growth comes the power of growth in the physical, and the end of the life of the *nefesh* is dressed in the blood. In the blood there are various things, and one of them is the DNA: the DNA of the body comes from the *Malchus* of the letters of the soul. The upper form is not necessarily like the lower form.

blocks.title: A blob of jelly
blocks.text: It is known that in the first cell of conception the whole form of the person is already there. Look at it and you say: what are you talking about? It doesn't look like a person; it is a teeny tiny blob of jelly, like an amoeba. Now they have super microscopes and can show you the actual strand of DNA, and it looks like a helix, not a person. Yet it is known that there are actual letters programmed in there.

According to the soul, the body is built up to receive its powers. As the first cell separates into many, different cells build up different organs to receive different powers: the eyes are made in a certain way to receive the power of sight. From the end of the light comes the beginning of the *kli*. So the end of the light of the intellect is blended into the brain.

sections.title: Vessel and light grow together: education and the brain
sections.summary: Matter and form grow as one, most clearly the brain with the light of the intellect. A child who is not educated becomes stupid because the light was not put in; the brain of one who fills it with spiritual light grows until seventy, and the brain of one who does not declines.

phrases.he: ולזאת אנו רואים שבכל מקום באין הגדלת החומר עם הגדלת הצורה כאחד ממש
phrases.en: So we see that the *tzura* grows with the *chomer*.

phrases.he: כמו בהגדלת חומר כלי הגוף, שנגדלים ביחד עם גידול אור וחיות הצורה הרוחניות,
כמו גידול הכנת חומר המוח לפי ערך גידול האור והצורה של השכל,
שכאשר יגדל התינוק ויצמח אור שכלו ברוחניותו, ממילא יצמח כלי הכנת מוחו

blocks.text: So **we see that the *tzura* grows with the *chomer***. Like what? The vessels of the body grow together with the light, mainly in the fetus. Later it is less evident: when a child grows, everything just seems to get bigger and the form does not change. Except the most evident case, the brain, which grows with the light of the intellect: a little child does not have the brains he will have when he grows up.

blocks.question: Why not say, as before, that the light stays the same and only the brain grew?
blocks.text: Because it is not just that the brain grew. A child who gets no education actually becomes stupid, and later it is too late, because his brain will not grow properly: the proper light was not put into it. In the same way, using the power of movement is what made a man into a muscle guy.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב ימים ידברו ורוב שנים כו'
phrases.en: *Davka* with days and years.

phrases.he: שנגדל הכלי עם האור יום יום עד ע' שנה, שבא לכלל גדלות המוחין כידוע ודי למבין:

blocks.text: "Days speak, and many years": *davka* **with days and years**. But it is not just days and years, because, as it says, an old *am ha'aretz* (an ignorant man) becomes stupider. It is *davka* the one who fills his brain with spiritual light whose brain actually improves: the vessel grows with the light day by day until seventy years, the *gadlus hamochin* (the full maturity of the mind).

Your normal American who just watched football his whole life: go on Rosh Hashana to do *mivtzoim* (the outreach campaigns) in the hospitals and you'll see they didn't get smart. It's the opposite: "they get stupider and stupider."

sensitivity.reason: Says the normal American who watched football all his life gets stupider and stupider, as seen in hospital visits.
sensitivity.publishable: Someone who never exercised his mind his whole life: go on Rosh Hashana to do *mivtzoim* (the outreach campaigns) in the hospitals and you'll see they didn't get smart. It's the opposite: the mind declines.

reviewQuestions.question: Why are the ten *sefiros* called *bli ma* from the side of the lights, and what makes a *sefira* what it is?
What are the three rulers above, what do they do in the body, and which levels of the soul do they hold?
A man who trains can lift three times as much. Has the light of his soul grown?
How does a mother lifting a car off her child show that the limit comes from the vessel?
In what sense is the whole person already in the first cell, though it looks like a blob of jelly?
If the light of the soul is the same, why does a child who gets no education grow up stupid?

notes.text: Class 041 opens (w0-354) by finishing the discussion of chapter 26 from the previous tape (040): the three levels of the intellect, the arms of Arich, the inner union of Abba and Moshiach. Chapter 26's file is written from tape 040 and does not have it, so it is kept here as recap blocks under lines 1-2, which sum chapter 26 up, with outOfPlace. A reviewer may prefer to move it to chapter 26.
w1281-1285 reads "Full רמ״ח, so that's 283": a mishearing; the count before the five chassadim is 243 (line 21). Left out of the block.
The weightlifting mashal opens "you know, the Governor, before you take weight lifting" (w1659-1665), probably a reference to Arnold Schwarzenegger; left out of the block.

Alignment: line 37 (uknaueqb, conf 0.457) is read at w1648 as "מכח כבדות עול בהגבלת משאו"; he rereads it at w2259-2276 before line 38, and the phrase's English ("how much he can lift") is taken from that rereading. The line-31 mark (w1532) falls on a rereading of line 30; line 31 itself is read at w1549.

"As it says, an old am ha'aretz becomes stupider" (w3354-3384): he gives no source; the block keeps it as he said it, unflagged, since it is a stated teaching. The football aside that follows is flagged.

The Down syndrome, pregnancy and food-supplement remarks (w1798-2142) are flagged health-or-legal with recommend judgment: the teaching (the vessel, not the soul, is damaged) is clear and his; the medical claims are his and unchecked.
"Like what he says in Tanya" (w2156-2200), on the holiness at the time of marital union and a high soul coming to a low person: kept as he gave it, without a chapter reference.
